description: Generated by go generate ./internal/config from the struct tree; do not edit.

allowed_origins.description: Exact origins (scheme://host[:port]), no wildcards. Empty: CORS is off and no Access-Control-Allow-* header is sent.

idempotency_retention.description: How long the outcome of an Idempotency-Key is replayed (R-API-014).

max_request_body_bytes.description: Largest JSON request body of /api/v1/; larger answers 413 (R-API-017).

page_size_default.description: limit of a list request that sends none (R-API-010).

page_size_max.description: Largest limit; a larger one is clamped to it (R-API-010).

exempt_admins.description: Callers who hold the admin capability bypass the limits.

requests_per_second.description: Sustained rate; the window is burst divided by this, at least 1s.
Sustained rate; the window is burst divided by this, at least 1s.

allowed.description: The operator's ceiling. The runtime switch anonymousAccess (R-AUTH-040) takes effect only while this is true.

check_interval.description: How often a replica of role api (or web, all) looks at the password file for a rotation.

enabled.description: The one local account; disable it once an OIDC administrator exists.

password_file.description: Argon2id PHC hash or plaintext password; read by the replicas of role api (and web while the bridge runs, all locally) only (R-AUTH-042).

rotation_hold.description: Local login is refused this long after a password rotation was noticed (Q-AUTH-14).

enabled.description: Off breaks NuGet restore and _auth users; Basic with a password is impossible regardless.

nuget_api_key_header.description: Examine X-NuGet-ApiKey on the routes that declare the API key: NuGet push, delete, relist (R-AUTH-033).

auto_redirect.description: Redirect the login page to the provider when exactly one is configured.

providers.description: Login providers by ID; see R-AUTH-004. Keys of an entry that are left out take the defaults of R-AUTH-004, R-AUTH-007 and R-AUTH-008.

device_code_failures.description: Wrong device user codes per user within auth.cli_login.ttl, cluster-wide.

exempt_cidrs.description: Client addresses or CIDRs that are never throttled.

failures_per_address.description: Rejected credentials per minute and client address, cluster-wide; a per-replica share while Valkey is unavailable.

recent_token_window.description: Throttle exemption of a credential validated on any replica.

starts_per_address.description: Requests to the unauthenticated row-creating endpoints per minute and address, cluster-wide.

revocation_bound.description: Revocation bound; at least 2 x cluster.epoch_poll_interval.

absolute_timeout.description: Ends a session this long after its creation.

idle_timeout.description: Ends a session this long after its last request (R-AUTH-010).

max_per_user.description: Concurrent sessions of one user; one more ends the oldest.

recent_auth_window.description: Credential-minting actions need an interactive authentication this recent (R-AUTH-011).

default_ttl.description: Lifetime of a Bastion token when the request names none: one year (R-BAS-004).

max_ttl.description: Ceiling of a Bastion token's lifetime: one year and a month, so a yearly renewal fits its overlap (R-BAS-004).

cache_ttl.description: SafetyTTL of the four auth caches; bounds staleness only if an invalidation were lost.

max_ttl.description: Hard ceiling; the CI exchange sets the issued lifetime.

expiry_notice.description: A token expiring within this period produces one token.expiring event; runtime-adjustable.

last_used_granularity.description: A token's last-used time is written at most once per this period, however often and on however many replicas the token is used.

bst.description: Unrevoked Bastion tokens per registration, so that a renewal's overlap fits (R-BAS-004).

allowed_groups.description: Empty: every user may create personal tokens; otherwise only members of these groups (R-AUTH-017).

max_ttl.description: Ceiling for the runtime setting; at most 876000h (100 years), the largest maximum the revocation journal replays (R-AUTH-041).

retention_after_end.description: The token-cleanup task deletes a token row this long after expiry or revocation.

allow_non_expiring.description: Lets an administrator create a service-account token without expiry.

max_ttl.description: Ceiling for the runtime setting; at most 876000h (100 years), the largest maximum the revocation journal replays (R-AUTH-041).

reads.description: Which reads are audited: none, denied (refused reads) or all (allowed reads too; the volume follows the downloads, Q-AUTHZ-5).

max_staleness.description: No decision is made on a grant index that was not confirmed current for longer; a request waits for a confirmation, then is answered 503 authz_stale (Q-AUTHZ-13). At least three times cluster.epoch_poll_interval; start-up refuses a lower value.

safety_ttl.description: Full rebuild of the grant index at least this often, jittered by up to 10 percent; it bounds a write path that changed an input without notifying.

hide_existence.description: A refused read answers 404, indistinguishable from a missing resource (R-AUTHZ-016, R-AUTHZ-017); false answers 403 for a resource that exists, for troubleshooting only. A repository's hideExistence overrides it.

role_bindings.description: System role bindings declared here (R-AUTHZ-010, Q-AUTHZ-170): trove migrate applies them with source configuration and removes the configuration bindings no longer listed; the API and the UI show them read-only. Each entry names role and exactly one of group, user and service_account. Whoever controls the membership of a declared IdP group holds the role.

group.description: A group; one that does not exist is created as a local group, which the login provider's group sync then fills (R-AUTH-008).

role.description: A system role: admin, security-admin, auditor, repository-admin or webhook-admin.

service_account.description: A service account; one that does not exist stops trove migrate.

user.description: A user; one that does not exist stops trove migrate.

compression_level.description: zstd level of table files and the blob list.

bytes_per_second.description: Transfer rate cap per run; 0 is unlimited.

part_size.description: Raised so that an object fits 10,000 parts.

lock_timeout.description: Wait for the table locks of the snapshot.

migration_wait.description: Wait for a running migration's lock.

parallel.description: Export connections besides the snapshot connection.

part_size.description: Multipart part size of table files.

remote_caches.description: Leave out blobs that only remote-repository caches reference.

expected_interval.description: How often a backup is expected. TroveBackupStale and the overdue mark of the API and the UI fire after 1.5 times this value (R-BAK-014).

finalize_timeout.description: Request deadline of the manifest write; twice this value must stay below lease_duration (R-BAK-010).

object_versioning.description: Asserts that the blob bucket is versioned and keeps noncurrent versions for at least recovery_window (R-HA-023).

recovery_window.description: The point-in-time recovery window the platform keeps (R-HA-023); 0s is undeclared. The task backup-check verifies it and a replica refuses to start when it exceeds storage.gc.grace_period without object_versioning (R-HA-024).

sweep_interval.description: A full pool sweep at least this often.

run_history.description: backup_run rows older than this are deleted by the next run.

separate_credentials.description: Read the blob bucket with backup.source.credentials instead of storage.s3.credentials.

stall_timeout.description: A run without progress for this long cancels itself and exits 75 (R-BAK-013).

allow_same_bucket.description: Allows the target on the blob store's endpoint and bucket, for single-bucket evaluation setups; the prefixes still must not contain each other (R-BAK-002).

ca_file.description: Empty means the system trust store.

endpoint.description: Empty means AWS endpoint resolution for the region. A host without a scheme means https://.

verify_sample.description: Pool objects HEAD-checked before each manifest.

max_repositories.description: Repository keys one check may ask about (R-BAS-011).

events_burst.description: Download events one window of the limiter admits; at least max_batch, so that every batch can fit (R-BAS-016). Charged in units of 100 events.

events_per_second.description: Download events one registration may report per second across the replicas (R-BAS-016); a batch beyond the budget is answered 429 with Retry-After and sent again by the Bastion.

max_age.description: An event older than this is not recorded and counts as dropped (R-BAS-016).

max_batch.description: Events one request of the intake accepts (R-BAS-016).

lookback.description: A feed read returns every entry newer than its cursor minus this period, so a transaction that committed late is not missed; longer than any transaction (the replay margin of R-HA-054).

max_page.description: Entries one feed read returns at most (R-BAS-015).

max_registrations.description: Bastion registrations that may exist; also bounds the bastion label of the interface metrics (R-BAS-004).

trusted_proxies.description: Addresses or CIDRs the Bastions connect from: their forwarded client address and host count only on a request whose Bastion token was recognized (R-BAS-017). Do not list them in server.trusted_proxies. A /0 prefix is refused.

snapshot_safety_ttl.description: Full reload of the repository snapshot.

unknown_repo_keys.description: Per replica: negative cache of unknown repository keys.

enabled.description: false answers every exchange with 404 and registers no limiter state.

expose_reason.description: false leaves the reason member out of the 400 answers; logs and audit keep it (R-CI-008).

max_body_bytes.description: Largest request body of the exchange.

exempt_cidrs.description: Client addresses or CIDRs that skip the per-address limiter, for example a runner network behind NAT. They stay bounded by server.max_in_flight and the per-subject limiter.

per_client_ip_per_minute.description: Limiter ci_exchange_address: requests per client address and minute, cluster-wide.

per_subject_per_minute.description: Limiter ci_exchange_subject: exchanges per CI issuer and subject (the first pin claim, usually project_id) and minute, cluster-wide.

retention.description: Issuance records whose token expired longer ago than this are deleted by the task ci-issuance-retention. Go durations have no day unit.

issuers.description: CI issuers declared here (R-CI-001, Q-CI-16): trove migrate applies them by name with source configuration, in one transaction, and disables the configuration issuers no longer listed; the API and the UI show them read-only. Each entry carries the fields of the issuer API in snake_case with the same validation and defaults; name, kind and issuer are required.

enabled.description: The CI_JOB_TOKEN fallback is not built (R-CI-022, Q-CI-5); true stops the start.

cache_safety_ttl.description: SafetyTTL of the in-process copy of the issuers and their mappings (R-ARCH-018).

max_per_issuer.description: Most mappings of one CI issuer.

max_per_project.description: Most mappings of one project's tier on one CI issuer, at most max_per_issuer: no project fills the issuer's limit alone (Q-CI-49).

retention_after_expiry.description: How long a recorded jti is kept after the subject token's exp plus the issuer's clock skew; at least 1m, so a replica whose clock lags the database's by less than that never accepts a single-use subject token whose row ci-replay-cleanup deleted (Q-CI-51).

warn_after_exchanges.description: From this exchange count of one subject token on, every further exchange of an issuer without single use records ci.exchange.repeated.

cache_safety_ttl.description: SafetyTTL of the in-process copy of the key sets (R-ARCH-018).

default_refresh_interval.description: Next refresh of a key set whose response carries no Cache-Control max-age.

fetch_timeout.description: Timeout of one discovery or key request.

max_refresh_interval.description: Upper clamp of the refresh interval.

max_response_bytes.description: Largest discovery or key response read.

max_stale.description: Age of the stored key set after which exchanges answer 503 signing_keys_unavailable.

min_refresh_interval.description: Lower clamp of the refresh interval; also the retry delay after a failed fetch.

unknown_kid_refresh_interval.description: At most one on-demand fetch per issuer and replica for a token whose kid is unknown (R-CI-003).

default_ttl.description: Lifetime of a CI token when the request names none.

max_ttl.description: Upper bound of every CI token; at most auth.tokens.cit.max_ttl (R-CI-016).

min_ttl.description: Shortest lifetime worth issuing; a subject token with less left answers subject_token_expires_too_soon.

epoch_max_staleness.description: The invalidation readiness check; at least the readiness window of R-HA-008.

flight_lock_ttl.description: Extended every ttl/3 while the fetch runs.

secrets_dir.description: Directory of the files that a secretRef {"file": name} names; a name is a file directly under it (R-REPO-033, R-OPS-029).

allow_insecure.description: Permits ssl_mode disable, allow and prefer.

control_host.description: Control pooler host; empty means host.

control_name.description: Database entry of the control pooler; empty means name.

host.description: Host name; a comma-separated list is allowed (R-HA-009).

max_conns.description: At least 2: one is the control connection.

expected_serving_replicas.description: The replicas of every Deployment without a lease pool (api, packages and their pools) together. Set by the chart on the migration Job.

expected_web_replicas.description: Deprecated alias of expected_serving_replicas, read while that key is 0 (R-ARCH-025).

expected_worker_replicas.description: Set by the chart on the migration Job.

max_elapsed.description: Request deadlines may cut it shorter.

session_host.description: Direct host for session-scoped connections; empty means host.

database_outage_grace.description: A replica that was ready stays ready while PostgreSQL has been unreachable for less than this; 0 disables it. Must be below database.retry.max_elapsed.

require_object_store.description: True makes the object store gate readiness continuously.

shutdown_drain_delay.description: Must exceed the edge's endpoint removal time.

watchdog_timeout.description: Bound for the watched loops of liveness.

exclude_queues.description: Queues this worker does not claim; empty: none. Mutually exclusive with queues. As an environment variable the list is written as JSON, for example TROVE_JOBS_EXCLUDE_QUEUES='["index","mirror"]'.

queues.description: Queues this worker claims; empty: every queue. Mutually exclusive with exclude_queues. As an environment variable the list is written as JSON, for example TROVE_JOBS_QUEUES='["index"]'.

retention.description: How long finished jobs are kept.

mirror.description: The passes of mirrored remote repositories and their dispatch (R-REPO-053).

ops_listener.description: Also log probe and metrics requests.

redact_query_params.description: Query parameters whose value is redacted in the request path and in logged URLs (R-OPS-010, R-OPS-013).

ring_buffer_bytes.description: Upper bound of the bytes the ring buffer holds; the oldest records go first. A record above 16 KiB is kept as a stub.

repository_label_include.description: Selectors of an instance context (R-AUTHZ-004), such as web/npm-* or */nuget-*, that give the repositories they match a series of their own before the others; a repository is named by its qualified name <projectKey>/<repoKey>, a bare key stops startup (R-OPS-007).

advisory_lock_wait.description: How long to wait for another migrator.

abbreviated_time.description: Add the time map to abbreviated package documents, which pnpm and Yarn need for release-age policies (R-NPM-011).

document_max_age.description: max-age of the Cache-Control header of package documents; 0 makes clients revalidate every time, which a 304 makes cheap (R-NPM-013).

manifest_consistency.description: A request manifest that differs from the tarball's package.json: reject answers 400 npm_manifest_mismatch, warn audits the difference, accepts the publish and stores the request's manifest.

max_tarball_size.description: Largest tarball of a publish; at most storage.upload.max_size.

max_unpacked_size.description: Largest sum of the unpacked entry sizes of a tarball.

retry_window.description: How long a repeated publish of identical bytes is acknowledged as the first one (Q-NPM-11); 0s turns the acknowledgement off.

max_compression_ratio.description: Largest compression ratio of an entry read into memory; at most the 100:1 of R-ARCH-028.

max_entries.description: Most entries the central directory of a package may declare (Q-NUGET-23).

max_nuspec_bytes.description: Largest .nuspec of a package; at most the 1 MiB of R-ARCH-028 (Q-NUGET-25).

max_uncompressed_bytes.description: Largest sum of the declared sizes of all entries of a package (Q-NUGET-23).

inline_below.description: A package with fewer visible versions has every page inlined in its registration index; with more, the pages are fetched from their own URL.

default_take.description: Results of a search that names no take.

max_skip.description: Largest skip; a larger one answers 400.

max_take.description: Largest take; a larger one is clamped.

remote_result_ttl.description: How long the answer of a forwarded search is kept; 0s keeps none. The engine cuts it to one hour (Q-NUGET-16).

virtual_merge_window.description: How many results of each member a search through a virtual repository merges; positions beyond it answer an empty data (R-NUGET-018).

role.description: Role of this replica: api, packages, worker, web (the bridge of the upgrade across the cut) or all (local development only). No default.

blocked_content_types.description: Media types an upstream answer may not have where integrity.blockUnexpectedContentTypes is true (R-REPO-042); lower-case type/subtype without parameters.

remote_refusal.description: A remote repository refuses a name that a global claim covers, also when addressed directly.

fetch_wait_timeout_seconds.description: How long a request waits for another replica's fetch of the same path; after it the request fetches without the cross-replica lock (R-REPO-026).

global_offline.description: No remote repository contacts its upstream; the runtime switch cannot lift it (R-REPO-031).

lock_poll_interval_ms.description: How long a waiter for a flight lock waits for the outcome message before it checks the lock key again (R-REPO-026 step 4).

max_artifact_bytes.description: System value of limits.maxArtifactBytes: a larger upstream artifact is refused with 502 upstream_item_too_large (R-REPO-040).

max_concurrent_fetches.description: Per replica: upstream fetches in flight over all remote repositories (R-REPO-040).

max_redirects.description: Redirect hops followed per upstream request; one more answers 502 too_many_redirects (R-REPO-039).

merged_metadata_cache_bytes.description: Per replica: merged package documents of virtual repositories (R-REPO-020); 0 turns the cache off.

metadata_cache_bytes.description: Per replica: the bytes of recently served metadata documents of remote repositories by blob digest, so a fresh hit costs no object-store round trip (R-REPO-025); a document above an eighth of it is not kept; 0 turns the cache off.

negative_l1_entries.description: Per replica: entries of the in-process copy of the negative cache of remote repositories (R-REPO-028); about 100 bytes each.

query_cache_bytes.description: Per replica: the answers of pass-through queries to the upstreams of remote repositories, such as a package search (R-ARCH-013 step 6); an answer above the whole budget is not kept; 0 turns the cache off.

queue_timeout_seconds.description: How long a fetch waits for a free slot before it answers 503 with Retry-After: 5; 0 refuses at once (R-REPO-040).

lookup_wait.description: How long a request for a repository key that PostgreSQL knows and the snapshot does not waits for the change-log poll before it answers 503 (R-ARCH-011 step 2).

max_virtual_members.description: The most members one virtual repository may list (R-REPO-017).

memory_limit_bytes.description: Container memory limit; 0 means none known.

memory_limit_ratio.description: Share of the container memory limit given to the Go runtime.

active_key_id.description: Key ID used for encryption; every listed key decrypts.

encryption_key_files.description: Key files: 32 random bytes, base64; the file name without .key is the key ID.

base_url.description: Canonical external origin; empty is allowed for development only.

content_base_url.description: Separate content origin (P1); empty means one origin.

content_url_ttl.description: Lifetime of a signed content URL.

endpoints.description: Further endpoints by name (R-EP-001): each needs listen and base_url. The entry default may set only hosts, wildcard_host, host_roots, surface, auth, exposure, cache_fill, rate_limit_class and replica_header.

forwarded_header.description: The one header family the edge rewrites: X-Forwarded-* or Forwarded (RFC 7239). The other is never read.

listen.description: Client listener: UI, API, package protocols.

certificates.description: With inherit false: the ops listener's certificate/key pairs; empty means plain HTTP, allowed only while server.tls is plain too.

key_file.description: PEM private key of the certificate; read again on every reload, never logged.

client_auth.description: With inherit false: client certificates on the ops listener; probes present none, so require breaks HTTPS probes.

client_ca_file.description: With inherit false: CAs a client certificate on the ops listener must chain to.

inherit.description: true: the ops listener serves server.tls's certificates, min_version and reload_interval without client certificates; false: the keys below are its own block.

min_version.description: With inherit false: lowest TLS version of the ops listener.

reload_interval.description: With inherit false: reload interval of the ops listener's files.

shutdown_timeout.description: Bound for in-flight requests and running work at SIGTERM. 0 derives it: runtime.termination_grace_period minus health.shutdown_drain_delay minus 5 s, or 25 s when the grace period is unknown. An explicit value must fit the grace period.

certificates.description: Certificate/key pairs (PEM). SNI selects the pair whose names match, wildcard certificates included; the first pair is the default. Empty means plain HTTP.

key_file.description: PEM private key of the certificate; read again on every reload, never logged.

client_auth.description: none: no client certificate is requested; verify_if_given: a presented certificate must chain to client_ca_file; require: a client without one is refused in the handshake.

client_ca_file.description: PEM bundle of the CAs a client certificate must chain to (mutual TLS for the edge). Required unless client_auth is none.

min_version.description: Lowest TLS version accepted; TLS 1.3 is preferred either way.

reload_interval.description: How often every file of the block is read and compared by content. A changed certificate serves new handshakes within this interval.

trusted_proxies.description: Addresses or CIDRs of the edge that sets the forwarding header. A /0 prefix is refused.

hold_back.description: Tail withheld until the digest matched; 0 would release corrupted bytes before the check (R-STOR-013).

delete_settle.description: Also bounds, as half of it, how long after its object write an upload may insert the blob row (R-STOR-005).

ca_file.description: Empty means the system trust store.

endpoint.description: Empty means AWS endpoint resolution for the region. A host without a scheme means https://; plain HTTP needs http:// and allow_insecure_endpoint.

force_path_style.description: True for SeaweedFS, MinIO and Ceph RGW.

receive_window.description: HTTP/2 only: how far the store may send ahead of what trove has read of one object; it bounds what a slow download holds (Q-ARCH-241). The transport's own default is 4 MiB.

startup_check.description: Object-store conformance check before the first readiness (R-STOR-035).

max_bytes.description: Budget shared by all concurrent uploads of a replica; the chart derives it.

max_size.description: Largest upload; must fit spool.max_bytes on the roles web and all (a worker accepts no uploads).

bootstrap_anonymous_read.description: Until authentication ships, nobody holds system.read: true lets anonymous callers read /api/v1/system/info and /system/replicas. For the dev profile; removed with the identity work.

public_version.description: Expose the version to unauthenticated callers.

allow_insecure.description: Lets spans go to the collector in plaintext (an http:// endpoint, OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_INSECURE=true). Span metadata crosses the network unencrypted and unauthenticated; for a collector reached over loopback or a mesh sidecar only (INV-20).

ca_file.description: CA bundle that verifies the collector. Refused with an http:// endpoint, where it would have no effect.

endpoint.description: Collector endpoint, e.g. https://otel-collector.observability:4318. https unless allow_insecure is true. Without user information: credentials go into headers_file.

incoming_context.description: trusted_peers: continue an incoming traceparent only from tracing.trusted_peers; all: from every client; none: never. A context that is not continued becomes a span link.

trusted_peers.description: Addresses or CIDRs of peers that set a trace context trove may continue (a mesh sidecar, an internal caller). Empty: every request starts a new trace. Never the edge proxy, which passes the client's header through.

token_env_var.description: Name of the environment variable that snippets with credentials=env read the token from.

token_ttl.description: Lifetime the setup dialog asks for when it creates a token; at most auth.tokens.pat.max_ttl.

max_upload_bytes.description: Largest file the UI uploads through the content route of a repository; a larger PUT is answered 413 before the body is read, and the deploy dialog refuses it before it starts. 0 is unlimited. Token clients upload through /files/ and are not bound by it (R-API-025, Q-UI-106).

external_image_origins.description: Exact https origins (https://host[:port], no path, no wildcard) whose images a README may show. Every other external image is shown as a link. The same list becomes the img-src of the UI's Content-Security-Policy.

max_source_bytes.description: Largest README source that is rendered; a longer one is cut and the answer says so.

failure_threshold.description: Consecutive failed calls that open the circuit.

addresses.description: Sentinel host:port list; required in sentinel mode.

primary_name.description: Name in the Sentinels' monitor line; required in sentinel mode.

tls.description: Use valkey.tls for Sentinel connections too.

ca_file.description: Empty means the system roots (verify-full only); required with verify-ca.

server_name.description: Empty means the host name of each address.

enabled.description: false: no sync, no evaluation, no block and no client-audit mode local; the stored findings stay as they are.

enforcement.description: enforce refuses the downloads the findings block (R-VULN-015); report blocks nothing anywhere: the would-be blocks are counted in trove_vuln_downloads_blocked_total{mode="report"} and recorded with enforced false. The installation-wide override for an emergency and for measuring a policy before enforcing it.

max_rows.description: An export that would exceed this answers 422 export_too_large before anything is streamed.

resolved_retention.description: A resolved finding and its events are kept this long (400 days) after it resolved; the task vuln-findings-retention deletes older ones. A finding that is re-detected before that is kept. Go durations have no day unit.

public_upstreams.description: Per format ID, the hosts of the public registries. A remote repository whose upstream host is listed is matched with matchPublicAdvisories auto; any other remote is not_covered until it sets always. Replaces the whole map when set.

mode.description: Off, and only off is built in this release (P1). The operator who switches EPSS on decides whether the data's terms permit the installation's use: FIRST publishes the EPSS scores without a stated licence, its site reads "All Rights Reserved", and it asks for attribution in products that use the scores; trove makes no statement about what that permits.

repository.description: Mode repository: the qualified name <projectKey>/<repoKey> of a generic local repository.

url.description: The daily EPSS file; https only. Not fetched while mode is off.

mode.description: online, repository (kev/known_exploited_vulnerabilities.json in the mirror repository) or off; with off every known-exploited flag stays as it was last computed.

repository.description: Mode repository: the qualified name <projectKey>/<repoKey> of a generic local repository.

base_url.description: The root of the OSV export bucket; https only. The sync requests <ecosystem>/all.zip, <ecosystem>/modified_id.csv and <ecosystem>/<id>.json below it, never the global archive.

ecosystems.description: OSV ecosystems to import. Empty: every ecosystem of a format that has the vulnerability adapter in this release (npm, NuGet). The list may only narrow that set; an ecosystem without an adapter is refused.

full_resync_threshold.description: Changed records above which an incremental run turns into a full one.

max_archive_size.description: Largest archive accepted. The worker's spool (worker.spool.sizeLimit) must hold one archive plus headroom.

max_record_size.description: Largest advisory record, in the archive uncompressed and fetched singly. A larger record is rejected and counted, and the run goes on (R-VULN-004, Q-VULN-116).

max_shrink.description: The share of an ecosystem's stored records a full sync may delete. A larger shrink fails the run with shrink_refused and changes nothing; a manual run with {"acceptShrink": true} overrides it once.

mode.description: online: the worker role fetches the per-ecosystem archives (R-VULN-004); repository: it reads them from a generic local repository of the installation, for an air-gapped installation (R-VULN-005); off: the stored data stays as it is and ages, and is never deleted by turning the source off.

overlap.description: Subtracted from the time a download started to set the watermark, because the exporter writes the archive and the change file at different times (Q-VULN-11).

repository.description: Mode repository: the qualified name <projectKey>/<repoKey> of a generic local repository that holds osv/<ecosystem>/all.zip (R-VULN-005). Whoever holds deploy on it decides the advisory data of the installation.

timeout.description: Timeout of one archive download; a record or a part of the change file has 30 s.

stale_after.description: An ecosystem whose last successful sync is older than this is stale: evaluation and enforcement continue on the stored data, the report shows a banner and the alert TroveVulnerabilityDataStale fires. Staleness never affects readiness.
